Coherence: both follow the required 8-slide story with consistent cross-references, so this is a tie. {"winner":"B","reason":"Both decks have the same eight-slide structure, the same facts and similar teal styling. Deck B is meaningfully better because Deck A has two visible defects on core slides that B does not.
